messages:
maria_partnerships: Nebula Cloud asked for a tiny ref-arch + Terraform starter to wire Redwood Private into their managed K8s and customer VPC. They want a 1-click-ish demo and a short quickstart for the marketplace listing. Deadline: partner kickoff in 3 weeks.

sam_eng: Can we adapt the slim starter modules and add a nebula_adapter module (PrivateLink endpoint + KMS hook)? I can spin up an examples/nebula with a sample app.

toni_infra: Two network options: VPC peering (faster setup) or PrivateLink (preferred by Nebula). I'll write a short decision doc with IAM and cost notes.

liz_docs: I'll draft a 1-page quickstart and a diagram. Need exact terraform var names and sample outputs for screenshots.

alex_partner_eng: Nebula prefers PrivateLink. I can provision a stage tenant for testing if you push an alpha branch.

sam_eng: I'll open an alpha PR today with a minimal TF snippet and an operator CRD. Sample snippet:

```terraform
module "redwood_nebula" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/nebula-adapter?ref=alpha"
  nebula_region = "us-east-1"
  redwood_endpoint = var.redwood_endpoint
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```

maria_partnerships: Owners: sam = module + PR, toni = infra variants doc, liz = quickstart. Check-in next Mon 9am PT.
